0022600225.text: The Houston Rockets (7-3, 2nd in the Southwest and 1 game back, 7th in the West) host the Golden State Warriors (7-3, 2nd in the Pacific and 2 games back, 6th in the West), with Houston on a two-game losing streak and Golden State riding a seven-game winning streak. Houston is missing Clint Capela (ankle sprain), Oscar Tshiebwe (illness), and Steven Adams (calf strain), while Golden State is without Gary Payton II (knee inflammation), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Will Richard (thumb). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Rockets won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 117-116 win in San Francisco on April 5, 2026.
